newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TWO REAL MADRID GOALKEEPERS SET TO LEAVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO REAL MADRID GOALKEEPERS SET TO LEAVE.

text.p: Real Madrid's two Spanish international goalkeepers Francisco Buyo and Jose Canizares look set to leave the club in the coming weeks.
Spanish sports daily AS reported on Sunday that Buyo, 39, would leave the Spanish champions after 11 seasons with them.
Buyo was the first-choice goalkeeper during much of that time, until the signing of German international Bodo Illgner at the start of last season.
He has not played in the Real Madrid first team since the arrival of Illgner.
Buyo has won seven Spanish caps and has played in 542 first-division games during his career with Real Madrid and six seasons with Sevilla.
Buyo has been linked with relegated Rayo Vallecano and Mexican club Atletico Celya.
Canizares, who has also been transfer listed, played as back-up to Illgner last year and to Buyo for two seasons before that but still managed to acquire nine caps.
But the 28-year-old Canizares's future with Real has been in doubt since new coach Jupp Heynckes signed Pedro Contreras from Rayo Vallecano.
